maya: FYI AE opened a POC request for CedarBridge, they want to bring `cedarbridge-13b-custom` (finetuned) for a 3-week eval. Needs private deploy (VPC) in eu-west-1, customer KMS, embeddings + chat. Asking: catalog onboarding path, runtime compatibility, and any enterprise blockers.

oliver: Do they provide tokenizer and model format? gguf/pytorch/onnx? Any adapters?

maya: Uploaded a tar with `model.gguf`, `tokenizer.json` (custom BPE), and `adapter_checkpoint.pt`. Also included an eval prompt set and a short security questionnaire.

sam: Quick notes: gguf loads fine. Custom BPE + adapter means we must run tokenizer compatibility and LoRA/adapter merge test. If adapter is not standard LoRA we may need to merge server-side which takes ops time.

infra-bot: [artifact-scan] model.gguf detected, tokenizer.json present, vocab 47k, special token mappings include non-standard <|pad_custom|>. Adapter file detected (PyTorch). No blocking license flags.

oliver: Perf: 13B at ~30 rps P95<180ms is tight in eu-west-1 depending on instance type. Options: dedicated pinned pool with warm replicas, int8 quant, or hybrid where embeddings use a smaller model. Also need to know if deterministic generation is required.

maya: They want deterministic outputs for evals. Also requested automatic fallback to a 7B distilled variant on capacity limits.

sam: Deterministic = set temperature=0 and top_p=1. Fallback route possible to `cedarbridge-7b-distill` but must document behavioral drift in SOW and run regression tests. Tokenizer shim possible but adds ~5-10ms.

security-bot: [sec-scan] Questionnaire flagged: KMS ARN missing, audit log retention TTL unspecified, and EU-only data residency requirement. Recommend customer provide Key ARN with policy granting RedwoodDeployRole kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey.

oliver: For private deploy we need either cross-account KMS policy or customer-managed deploy agent. Also confirm if raw input logging is allowed; by default we only store metadata (model id, token counts).

maya: I will ask AE to get KMS ARN and confirm audit log fields + TTL. Sam, can you run tokenizer compatibility and adapter merge smoke test? Oliver, can you size infra and give int8 vs fp16 cost delta?

sam: On it. Will run token checks and merge test, post mismatch report. If special tokens mismatch we'll request a regenerated tokenizer or propose a small shim.

oliver: I'll provide sizing and cost delta within 24h and recommend minimal deploy config to share with customer.

maya: Suggested minimal deploy config to propose:
```
model: cedarbridge-13b-custom
format: gguf
precision: int8
deploy_mode: private
region: eu-west-1
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 5
batching: {max_tokens: 1024, dynamic_window_ms: 10}
audit_mode: metadata-only
fallback_policy: route_to_cedarbridge_7b_on_capacity
```

infra-bot: [ticket] Created SW-4801 "CedarBridge POC - tokenizer + adapter onboarding" assigned to sam,oliver. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/SW-4801

maya: Thanks team  I'll loop in AE and ask the customer for KMS ARN and audit TTL. Ping here for blockers. :+1:
